description:
An empty tuple joined with a value of another type and passed to a function crashes the JIT and the native build; the interpreter is right:

    def show(x), do: x
    def main() do
      n = Process.heap_alloc_stats()[:allocs]
      dbg(show(if n < n + 1, do: {}, else: 5))
    end

interp prints {}. run and build panic at src/compiler2/native_codegen/terminator.rs:87: "continuation callee 35 expected at least 1 logical arg(s), got 0".

Works: `{1}` instead of `{}`; both branches `{}`; no call around the `if`. Suspected (unverified): the zero-width tuple gets no lane when it travels joined with another type into a call; the same family as fz-sc8.31. Before fz-sc8.31 the symptom was "StructField: subject is not a map or Struct". Not needed by the distiller.
title: An empty tuple joined with another type survives a call on the JIT and the native build
